A total of 16 teams will compete in the league. The season began on 22 February 2019 and is scheduled to conclude on 27 October 2019.{{cite web |url=http://www.foxsports.co.th/foot-ball/thai-football/69141/%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%AF%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%9C%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%A4%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B9%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A5/ |title=T1 and T2 schedules from Fox Sports |work=foxsports.co.th |publisher=Fox Sports |date=4 October 2018 |access-date=9 November 2018 |archive-date=10 November 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181110080309/https://www.foxsports.co.th/foot-ball/thai-football/69141/%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%AF%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%9C%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%A4%E0%B8%94%E0%B8%B9%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A5/ |url-status=dead }} [[Buriram United F.C.|Buriram United]] are the defending champions, while [[PTT Rayong F.C.|PTT Rayong]], [[Trat F.C.|Trat]] and [[Chiangmai F.C.|Chiangmai]] have entered as the promoted teams from the [[2018 Thai League 2]]. The 1st transfer window is from 26 November 2018 to 19 February 2019 while the 2nd transfer window is from 24 June 2019 to 19 July 2019.
